Choose a group size that suits the route, weather, walkers’ experience and the leader’s ability to supervise; for a large group, split into smaller groups only with a capable leader for each. Agree the route, pace and regrouping points beforehand. The leader stays at the front and sets a pace the slowest walker can manage; a back-marker stays with the last person, and both keep in touch. Count everyone at the start, junctions and stops, keep the group together, and don’t leave anyone behind.
